advanced.description: Extract TRAP incident ID (+ raw TRAP Severity) via the shared proofpoint_trap_extract_incident_id custom function.

proofpoint_trap_extract_incident_id.name: proofpoint_trap_extract_incident_id
proofpoint_trap_extract_incident_id.label: proofpoint_trap_extract_incident_id
proofpoint_trap_extract_incident_id.description: Read the TRAP incident ID and raw TRAP Severity off the container's Event Info/Event Info Update artifacts.

advanced.note: Reads incident_id/trap_severity from the extract_incident_id CF result; promotes container severity from trap_severity.
advanced.description: Bridge block: read extract_incident_id CF result (incident_id + trap_severity) and promote container severity.

3.userCode:
################################################################################

    result_rows = phantom.collect2(
        container=container,
        datapath=["extract_incident_id:custom_function_result.data.incident_id", "extract_incident_id:custom_function_result.data.trap_severity"],
    )
    incident_id_val, trap_severity = result_rows[0] if result_rows else (None, None)

    if not incident_id_val:
        phantom.error("Could not find Incident ID (cef.incidentId) on the 'Event Info' artifact")
        phantom.add_note(
            container=container,
            note_type="general",
            title="TRAP Triage - Error",
            content="Could not find Incident ID on the 'Event Info' artifact"
        )
        return

    read_incident_id__incident_id = str(incident_id_val)
    phantom.debug("Extracted incident ID: {}".format(read_incident_id__incident_id))

    severity_map = {"Critical": "high", "High": "medium", "Informational": "low"}
    mapped_severity = severity_map.get(trap_severity, "low")
    phantom.set_severity(container=container, severity=mapped_severity)
    phantom.debug(
        "Promoted container severity to '{}' (TRAP Severity: '{}')".format(
            mapped_severity, trap_severity
        )
    )

    ################################################################################

data.description: Automation playbook (PB2) triggered on container creation. Extracts the TRAP incident ID from container data and stops. Analyst-driven actions (comment/assignee/status, close) live in separate manually-launched playbooks: proofpoint_trap_acknowledge, proofpoint_trap_close.
